description.value: Your focus fires a magnetized tether line at a point, an object, or a creature within range. You can pull yourself up to 30 feet toward the anchor point, or pull an unattended object of up to 50 pounds to your position; a creature can instead be pulled 10 feet toward you if it fails a Strength saving throw.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
